tha-ap404:1.3: buddho → ābādhiko ca so buddho (bj: machasaṁ) | so → ābādhiko garu (cck: sī.) | yo → G. va so; S1 ca so. (pts note)

tha-ap404:3.3: vāḷā → vyagghā (bj) | vyagghā → vāḷā (bj: machasaṁ) | ca → byagghā (cck: sī.) | kesarī → S1 S2 -kesari; G. vāḷāvakesari. (pts note)
tha-ap404:3.4: abhigajjiṁsu → abhikujjiṁsu (sya-all) | abhigajjiṁsu → S1 abhigacchisu; S2 abhiñujiṁsu. (pts note)

tha-ap404:5.3: vītaccikaṁva → vītaccitaṁva (sya-all) | vītaccikaṁ → G. vitacchitaṁ. (pts note)

tha-ap404:9.2: agacchahaṁ → agañchahaṁ (sya-all) | agacch → S2 agañch' (pts note)
tha-ap404:9.3: dibbamayo → divyamayo (pts) | divyamayo → G. dibbamayo. (pts note)

tha-ap404:11.2: vattate → vattatī (bj, sya-all) | vattatī → vattate (bj: machasaṁ) | vattate → S1 S2 vattatī (pts note)
